observations: Pre-existing and outside this change: /healthz runs its NATS reads (FlushTimeout, each cache's Ping, ConsumerInfo with the handle's 10 s MaxWait) inside the HTTP server's 10 s WriteTimeout, so while JetStream does not answer a request can get no response at all (curl HTTP 000 after about 10 s) rather than a 503. Seen once, on a 3-node cluster just after the node the listener was connected to was killed; the c939145e2b04 binary did the same, and the ConsumerInfo read is in main's handler too. A health check reads either as unhealthy, so no acceptance criterion is affected.

natsURLWithoutUserinfo renders a URL with an '@' after its authority (tls://tok@host:4222/x@y) as what follows the last '@' ('y'), losing the host from the refusal. It is safe and the unit table pins it; such a URL is not a usable NATS URL.

The listener installs its SIGTERM handler only after the durable binds (main.go:776), so a SIGTERM during startup kills it with the default action (exit 143) and no shutdown lines. Unchanged by this pull request.
